  xaringan::moon_reader:
    lib_dir: "libs"

      highlightStyle: github

        scroll: true

  chunk_output_type: console

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.retina = 3, fig.align = "center",
                      dev = "ragg_png")  # ragg finds Fira Sans Condensed on Windows
```

```{r packages-data, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

set.seed(15)
scores <- tibble(score = rnorm(500, mean = 75, sd = 10))
```

```{r xaringanExtra, echo=FALSE}
xaringanExtra::use_xaringan_extra(c("tile_view"))
```

# Every plot needs alt text

```{r score-hist, echo=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=4.2, out.width="85%", fig.alt="Histogram of 500 simulated test scores, roughly bell-shaped and centered at 75"}
ggplot(scores, aes(x = score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2.5, fill = "#538ba2", color = "white") +
  labs(x = "Test score", y = "Students") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Fira Sans Condensed", base_size = 18)
```
